name: Semicoa
old_description: Manufactures discrete silicon semiconductors for military, aerospace and space customers at its Hawthorne, California site.
about:
Semicoa operates from Hawthorne, California, where it has specialized in discrete silicon semiconductors for more than 50 years. The company focuses on the design, development, and wafer fabrication of high-reliability devices for demanding environments.

Its product line includes bipolar power transistors, small-signal transistors, radiation-hardened devices, and ceramic surface-mount diodes. Semicoa performs discrete and hybrid assembly on dedicated high-volume lines, leveraging proprietary scalable processes that integrate with foundry partners. The facility provides in-house environmental and life testing per MIL-PRF-19500, including radiation lot acceptance, real-time X-ray, PIND testing, and fine/gross leak testing with Krypton 85.

The company serves military, aerospace, space, and defense customers worldwide. Its components have been used in smallsat programs, spacecraft, and other mission-critical systems where failure is not an option. Semicoa supports qualified parts lists (QPL) and source control drawings (SCDs) with full traceability to wafer and diffusion runs.

Semicoa differentiates itself through the highest U.S. government qualification (JANS level per MIL-PRF-19500) and certifications to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015. Its modular process development, custom packaging and plating options, and comprehensive documentation capabilities are designed to meet the stringent requirements of space-level applications.
